title: Assemble interaction matrix and evidence kit for screenreader & keyboard flows in miniature widgets
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: produce a compact, machine-readable interaction matrix and a companion evidence kit that documents ARIA attributes, keyboard focus order, and contrast decisions for miniature UI patterns (compact buttons, pill filters, condensed tables, micro charts). This ticket scopes the audit synthesis and evidence packaging needed for the VPAT submission and to unblock engineering remediations. Deliverables: 1) canonical interaction matrix CSV/Confluence table mapping states -> expected screen reader text/role/focus behavior, 2) contrast rationale doc with color token usage and WCAG calculations, 3) Figma annotations for the top 12 high-risk widgets, 4) test plan + playback scenarios for assistive tech QA, 5) a lightweight PR checklist for engineers to include when addressing fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical interaction matrix created and reviewed (rows: widget+state, columns: role, aria attrs, keyboard nav, SR announcement, fail-mode)
Contrast evidence doc with WCAG 2.1 AA calculations and fallback token recommendations for all tokens used in compact widgets
Figma file annotated for 12 example widgets and shared with engineering; annotation layer includes aria and focus examples
Test plan with 10 deterministic assistive-tech scenarios + steps to reproduce is published to Confluence
VPAT evidence bundle zipped in Drive with links in the Confluence page and a short README for reviewers
comments: 2025-01-28 Maya Patel: Kickoff - collected existing token mappings and the accessibility lab's recent microchart report. Scoped to compact density only to keep MVP small.

2025-02-03 Liam O'Connor: Ran a baseline keyboard walkthrough for compact table rows. Found inconsistent row focus styling and missing aria-rowindex on virtualized lists. Added to matrix as high-risk.

2025-02-11 Sophia Nguyen (PM): Prioritizing pill filters and compact action buttons for VPAT because enterprise customers flagged them in pre-audit. Request: include explicit fallback tokens for high-contrast mode.

2025-02-18 Carlos Rivera (Eng): Reviewed matrix draft; proposed two engineering trade-offs: 1) add automatic focus-rehydration on modal reopen (incurs minor runtime cost), 2) prefer aria-hidden + live region announcements vs complex role rewriting for certain microcharts. Marked for follow-up evaluation.

2025-02-22 Liam O'Connor: Contrast pass completed for dark & light themes using axe-core color-contrast and manual luminance checks. Documented three token pairs failing AA on 12px labels — proposed token swap to a mid-level emphasis token.
2025-02-26 Maya Patel: Figma annotations updated; added example keyboard-flow GIFs (link in Confluence) to illustrate tab + shift-tab sequences for nested controls.

2025-03-01 Accessibility Lab: Ran VoiceOver and NVDA scenarios from the test plan. Findings: microchart aria-labels inconsistent across variants; screen reader often announces duplicate labels when prefix caching present. Added remediation notes and suggested aria-describedby usage.

2025-03-03 Liam O'Connor: Draft PR created for token swaps and focus-outline CSS variables — see GitHub PR. Eng requested design approval on fallback token contrasts before merging. Assigned designer to approve contrast deltas.

2025-03-04 Maya Patel: Preparing VPAT evidence bundle. Need PM sign-off on release inclusion and legal copy for accessibility statement. Moving to in-review for design artifacts; engineering tasks are blocked until token confirmations are approved.
